name: Moonchain Drone: Crypto-native drone
description: Meet the Moonchain Drone — the first-ever autonomous, crypto-native drone distributed through an Initial Hardware Offering (IHO). Engineered for performance, connectivity, and profitability, the IHO Drone isn’t just a flying machine — it’s a physical validator in your decentralized economy.

name: Moonchain Grip: The Ultimate Mobile Game Controller
description: Introducing the Moonchain Grip — a next-generation mobile gaming controller engineered for precision, speed, and immersive gameplay. Designed for both Android and iPhone users, the Moonchain Grip redefines mobile esports with pro-level control and Web3-powered ownership.

name: Moonchain Headphones: Sound Meets On-Chain Utility
description: The Moonchain Headphones redefine what it means to listen with purpose. Delivered through our exclusive Initial Hardware Offering (IHO), these wireless headphones fuse high-fidelity audio with blockchain utility — no upfront cost, just stake-to-own.

name: Moonchain Smart Watch: Engineered for performance and style
description: Introducing Moonchain Smart Watch, where cutting-edge design meets real-world utility. Engineered for performance and style, this sleek wearable tracks your health, keeps you connected, and syncs seamlessly with your crypto-powered lifestyle.

name: Moonchain Mining: Multi Token Miner
description: Step into the future of passive income with the IoT Multi-Token Miner, available exclusively through Moonchain’s Initial Hardware Offering (IHO). This compact, energy-efficient device connects seamlessly to your Wi-Fi and silently mines multiple on-chain tokens 24/7 — no technical setup, no noise, no hassle.

name: Moonchain Sunglasses: JBL wireless audio sunglasses
description: Introducing the ultimate fusion of fashion, function, and freedom — JBL Sunglasses powered by Moonchain. As part of our latest Initial Hardware Offering (IHO), you can now lock your $Moonchain tokens to claim a pair of wireless audio sunglasses crafted in collaboration with JBL, the global leader in sound innovation.

name: Moonchain DIMO: A GPS and health tracker for your car
description: DIMO Macaron is smartest way to track and improve the health and value of your car.

name: Moonchain VR: Oculus Quest 2
description: The Oculus Quest 2 is your all-in-one ticket to next-level virtual reality. With stunning graphics, wireless freedom, and a growing universe of immersive apps and games, it’s the ultimate VR headset for gamers, creators, and explorers.

name: Moonchain Ring: BlueBerry AI - WearFI
description: Unlock wellness at your fingertips. Get your Blueberry Ring now and start your journey to better health.

name: CyberCharge Web 3 Plug
description: The world’s first Web3 smart charger, CyberCharge transforms routine charging into a rewarding experience.

name: Nothing Headphone 1
description: The Nothing Headphone (1) redefines immersive listening with a custom-engineered 40mm dynamic driver, developed in collaboration with KEF for natural, studio-grade clarity.
